title: [CON-11] Relays must keep `pushHandle` → `channelTokens` registrations, which is outside the relay
description: Review finding CON-11: Relays must keep `pushHandle` → `channelTokens` registrations, which is outside the relay observation budget (lens CON). Location: spec/11-transport.md:160, :194-203; ARCHITECTURE.md:161 (item 7, "For push proxies only"); spec/12-security.md:22. Fix: Add a relay item to ARCH §5 for push registrations (`pushHandle`, proxy endpoint, registered `channelToken`s) and mirror it in §12.3. Define how registrations follow token rotation each epoch; 11:194-212 does not say. Q4 decided push-on, and the budget text was never updated. Full text: notes/review/CON-verified.md and notes/review/CON.md.
